summary: Manulife Financial Corp filed a Form 6-K with its first-quarter 2026 report to shareholders. The filing reports Q1 core earnings of $1.8 billion (up 8% CER), core EPS of $1.06 (up 11%), net income of $1.1 billion, and key metrics such as LICAT ratio of 136% and new business CSM growth of 16%. This is a routine periodic earnings release, not a special-situation event. The registrant is the filer reporting standard quarterly results. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is present. This is a routine earnings filing.
